name: McDonough Lateral
monitor_reason: length: the 19.7 mi 30-inch lateral is an existing line acquired by Southern Natural Gas, so the Fairburn Expansion adds no new pipe from it. Only 4.9 mi of new pipe and a 1.6 mi extension are proposed, both under the 25 km floor.
researcher_notes: A Federal Register notice of February 24, 2017 (FERC docket CP17-46) says Southern Natural Gas Company, L.L.C. will acquire an existing 19.7-mile, 30-inch lateral in Cobb and Fulton Counties, Georgia. It also proposes 4.9 miles of new 30-inch pipe, a 1.6-mile extension and 18,000 horsepower of compression. The notice does not use the name McDonough Lateral or mention Plant McDonough. That name comes only from the seed agent and is not confirmed. The acquired line becomes part of the Southern Natural Gas system, which is already a row (P0252). It is not a separate new pipeline and adds no new pipe, so it is not stageable as a new row. If a person wants the lateral tracked on its own, a check of the FERC filing for its name and former owner is needed first. Not checked beyond this notice.
